errors.evidence: The categories are arranged along the horizontal axis, not vertical.
The description does not provide information about the range or scale on the y-axis.
There is no mention of the absence of a legend explaining the color coding.
The description states 10% for 'Да се ограничат действията на мафията' but the figure indicates 10% only applies to this category, further corroborating this point could mislead.
The description indicates 13% for 'Да се подобри качеството на административните...' whereas the figure shows a different value.
